name: Multiplier
description_en:
Multiplier is a global employment and workforce platform with distinct Employer of Record, Global Payroll, Non-Resident Employer payroll and contractor products. Its payroll offering combines inputs, gross-to-net calculation, payslips, statutory processing, payment visibility and reporting, but the employer relationship depends on the selected service.

The key buying decision is whether the customer already has an entity, remains the employer under an eligible NRE arrangement, or needs an EOR. Public starting fees are separate from salary, statutory costs, mandatory benefits and applicable setup or payment charges.
description_zh:
Multiplier 是全球雇佣及人员平台，提供不同的名义雇主、Global Payroll、非居民雇主工资及承包人员产品。工资服务组合输入、税前到实发、工资单、法定处理、付款可见性及报表，但雇主关系取决于所选服务。

采购关键是客户是否已有实体、能否按合资格 NRE 安排继续担任雇主，或需要 EOR。公开服务起价与工资、法定成本、强制福利及适用设置付款费分开。

core_features.explanation_en: Payroll pages describe payment previews, payslips, expenses, adjustments and gross-to-net/cost-center reporting.
core_features.explanation_zh: 工资页描述付款预览、工资单、费用、调整及税前到实发、成本中心报表。

core_features.name_en: NRE payroll with retained employer status
core_features.name_zh: 保留雇主身份的 NRE 工资
core_features.explanation_en: NRE documentation says the customer remains the employer subject to local requirements, with registration and jurisdiction assessment.
core_features.explanation_zh: NRE 文档说明客户在当地要求下继续担任雇主，并需评估登记及辖区条件。

core_features.name_zh: 独立 EOR 及承包人员产品
core_features.explanation_en: Pricing distinguishes EOR Core/Growth, Contractor of Record, Contractors and Global Payroll instead of one universal plan.
core_features.explanation_zh: 价格区分 EOR Core/Growth、Contractor of Record、Contractors 和 Global Payroll，并非单一通用套餐。

pricing.summary_en: EOR Core $459 annual equivalent/$499 monthly; Growth $519/$559; Global Payroll $20 starting, Contractors $40, COR $400. Extras/country exceptions apply; invoice currency and NRE quote unverified.
pricing.summary_zh: EOR Core 年付月等值 $459/月度 $499，Growth $519/$559；Global Payroll $20 起、Contractors $40、COR $400。有附加及国家例外，发票币种及 NRE 报价未核实。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Decide who is the employer first
sections.en: The pricing FAQ says Global Payroll can be used where the customer has entities and EOR where it does not. The NRE page adds a third model: customers remain the employer, subject to local eligibility and registrations, without creating an entity in the worker’s country. EOR instead makes Multiplier or a partner the legal employer. These are materially different relationships. A pricing card broadly says Global Payroll needs no entity, but the more specific FAQ and NRE qualifications should be resolved in a country-specific proposal, not read as universal permission to employ anywhere without registration.
sections.zh: 价格 FAQ 称已有实体可用 Global Payroll，没有实体用 EOR。NRE 页增加第三种模式：客户在本地资格和登记要求下继续担任雇主，无需在员工所在国设立实体；EOR 则由 Multiplier 或伙伴担任法律雇主。这些关系实质不同。价格卡泛称 Global Payroll 无需实体，但应在各国方案中澄清它与具体 FAQ、NRE 限定的关系，不能理解为无需登记即可在任何地方雇佣。

sections.title_en: Trace inputs through preview and payment
sections.en: The payroll page describes centralized inputs, payslips, time-off and expense adjustments, payment previews and headcount, gross-to-net and cost-center reports. The NRE guide gives a sequence of worker/location assessment, salary components and registrations, approval of payroll inputs, localized payslips, payments and exported journals. For an illustrative employee moving countries, first validate which employer model applies, then reconcile salary, deductions, currency and the final payment status. A preview is not proof of bank settlement. Country coverage counts vary by product/page and do not establish identical filings or payment methods everywhere.
sections.zh: 工资页描述集中输入、工资单、休假费用调整、付款预览及人数、税前到实发、成本中心报表。NRE 指南给出人员地点评估、薪资组成和登记、批准输入、本地工资单、付款及日记账导出的顺序。跨国调动示例应先确认雇主模式，再核对工资、扣款、币种和最终付款状态。预览不证明银行结算。不同产品页面的覆盖数量不同，不能证明各地申报或付款方式完全一致。

sections.title_en: Separate EOR service from employment cost
sections.title_zh: 区分 EOR 服务与雇佣成本
sections.en: The pricing page lists EOR Core at $459 per employee monthly equivalent billed annually or $499 on monthly contracts; Growth at $519 annually equivalent or $559 monthly; Enterprise is quoted. It also states compliance-mandated add-ons and implementation fees may apply, and some countries have adjusted rates. Growth adds integration and report capabilities not assumed included in Core. Benefits administration in the service fee does not establish that insurance premiums or statutory contributions are covered by that fee. The dollar symbol is displayed, but a specific invoice currency was not independently confirmed. Obtain country, salary, benefits, taxes, setup, deposit and termination costs in writing.
sections.zh: 价格页列出 EOR Core 年付月度等值 $459、月度合同 $499；Growth 年付等值 $519、月度合同 $559；Enterprise 询价。页面还称可能有强制合规附加项及实施费，部分国家费率调整。Growth 增加集成及报表能力，不能假定 Core 已含。服务费含福利管理，不证明该金额已含保费或法定缴费。页面展示 $，未独立确认发票具体币种，需书面列明国家、工资、福利、税、设置、押金及终止成本。

sections.title_en: Do not substitute contractor or payroll fees for EOR
sections.title_zh: 不要把承包人员或工资费当作 EOR 费
sections.en: Global Payroll starts at $20 per employee monthly, with the card specifying annual billing and applicable setup, implementation, payment and statutory fees. Contractors lists $40 per contractor monthly billed annually, while Contractor of Record starts at $400 with additional stated conditions. Those figures describe different services, not cheaper equivalent EOR tiers. NRE pricing was not separately quantified in the reviewed source. The pricing FAQ says one employee can be hired, but exact minimum billing, country exceptions and annual cancellation treatment require confirmation. A calculator or “no credit card” invitation is not a verified free operational plan.
sections.zh: Global Payroll 每员工每月 $20 起，价格卡注明年付，并可能有设置、实施、付款及法定费用。Contractors 每承包人员每月 $40、年付，Contractor of Record 则 $400 起且另有条件。这些是不同服务，不能当成更便宜但等同的 EOR 档位。所读 NRE 来源未单独量化价格。价格 FAQ 称可从一名员工开始，但最低账单、国家例外及年度取消仍需确认。计算器或无需信用卡入口不是已核实的免费运营套餐。

sections.en: Multiplier may fit organizations consolidating cross-border employment or payroll, while a single-country employer should first assess whether the wider service model is necessary. Prepare entities, worker status, salary components, country registrations, balances and approvers; test a corrected input, rejected payment and exported journal in the contracted scope. NRE explicitly requires local assessment, and optional FX hedging is not a guarantee of zero currency risk. Broad compliance, security and on-time-payment promises are vendor claims, not independent audits. Contractual employer liability, product availability, exact fees, FX spread, banking, data hosting, retention, full exports and recovery remain unverified. No contract, onboarding, payroll, statutory filing or transfer was executed.
sections.zh: 需要整合跨境雇佣或工资的组织可评估 Multiplier，单一国家雇主则应先衡量是否需要更广服务。需准备实体、人员身份、薪资组成、国家登记、余额及审批人，并在合同范围测试更正输入、付款拒绝和日记账导出。NRE 明确需本地评估，可选汇率对冲不保证零汇率风险。广泛的合规、安全和准时付款承诺属于供应商声明，并非独立审计。合同雇主责任、产品可用性、具体费用、汇差、银行、托管、保留、完整导出及恢复仍未核实，未签约、入职、处理工资、申报或转账。
